title: Who is Rainer dela Fuente, the CPA lawyer witness for Duterte's defense?
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte"s defense counsel presented AML Consulting PH head Rainer dela Fuente as their witness for the 44th day of her impeachment trial -- but who is he?

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense counsel presented AML Consulting PH head Rainer dela Fuente as their witness for the 44th day of her impeachment trial — but who is he?

Dela Fuente, certified public accountant, was brought forward as a witness to testify on matters pertaining to the Anti-Money Laundering Act. During his introduction, Dela Fuente said that he obtained his Bachelor of Science in Applied Economics and Accountancy from De La Salle University in 2005.

He would go on to earn his law degree from San Beda College, graduating in 2011 and taking his oath as a lawyer in 2012. During his third year of law school, he worked at the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) as a revenue officer from 2009 to 2010.
Dela Fuente said that he was also a part of the Governance Commission for GOCCs (GCG) as an analyst.
Eventually, he became a financial investigator with the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) in 2015, with the designation of Bank Officer II.
In 2018, he also became an accredited trainer for the AMLC. He was also an accredited trainer for the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR).
Dela Fuente then founded the AML Consulting PH in 2021 with the focus of training, compliance work and research.
He also has experience as a consultant at AML Research Centre Asia-Pacific, as well as Cagayan Economic Zone Authority (CEZA). —VAL, GMA News
